title: Review: secretx URI support for all secrets
notes:
Maintainer risk: LOW — The secretx wiring is structurally correct and fails fast on startup. The three findings (test oracle violation, --check mode gap, silent behavior change in smtp) are real but none create runtime correctness failures in the happy path. The doc comment issue is cosmetic. The bigger maintenance concern is two copies of resolve_secret_uri and three patterns that a contributor won't know which to follow.
Confidence: 15% chance of missed bug. Uncertainty driven by: no integration test actually exercises a secretx: URI end-to-end (the secretx:env and secretx:file providers exist but no startup test exercises them). Would raise confidence if: an integration test exercised secretx:env:FOO for the admin token, credential_file, and TLS key, then confirmed the daemon accepts connections correctly.
